import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    if N < M:
        N, M = M, N
    pow_val = 1 << M
    counts = [0] * pow_val
    dp = [[[-1 for _ in range(pow_val)] for _ in range(pow_val)] for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(pow_val):
        counts[i] = bin(i).count('1')
        dp[0][i][0] = counts[i]
    spiders = float('inf')
    for y in range(N - 1):
        for i in range(pow_val):
            for j in range(pow_val):
                if dp[y][i][j] == -1:
                    continue
                for k in range(pow_val):
                    if (((i | (i << 1) | (i >> 1) | j | k) & (pow_val - 1)) == (pow_val - 1)):
                        value = dp[y][i][j] + counts[k]
                        if dp[y + 1][k][i] == -1 or dp[y + 1][k][i] > value:
                            dp[y + 1][k][i] = value
    for i in range(pow_val):
        for j in range(pow_val):
            if dp[N - 1][i][j] != -1 and ((i | (i << 1) | (i >> 1) | j) & (pow_val - 1)) == (pow_val - 1):
                spiders = min(spiders, dp[N - 1][i][j])
    print((N * M) - spiders)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
